intro.text: A nation on Canticle, founded and led by the Cinder King, which at its height covered almost the whole world apart from the poles, where life is barely possible.
An autocracy on Canticle covering almost the whole world, headed by the Cinder King, who claims the right to rule by strength and keeps it through propaganda, intimidation and violence.

description.text: Its capital, also called Union, is made of thousands of small ships of many shapes and uses that hover about forty feet up and keep moving forward across the land. They can be rearranged as needed, for instance into an arena. The Cinder King means for everyone to live there, and nearly every major city has been merged into it; a few small towns still roam separately under his officials and Charred.

The Cinder King holds the populace through the Charred, Invested soldiers who are stronger and hardier than ordinary people and obey only him. Beacon is the largest city still holding out against joining Union.
Prisoners and captives are sacrificed to make sunhearts, which power Union's cities. Metal is harvested from iron fields, places where molten metal covers the ground.
Most of Union's soldiers are ordinary troops armed with sunheart-powered guns, alongside the Charred.
